title: Clockwork Hours
statement: A mechanical watch is a small universe that runs on a coiled spring and patience. I restore them because every one carries the hands of everyone who wound it.

fragments.title: The escapement
fragments.text: Tick, tock: a tiny anchor letting the gear train escape one tooth at a time. It is the heartbeat of the watch and the most beautiful mechanism humans ever drew.

fragments.title: Engraved initials
fragments.text: Inside a 1931 case back: 'A. to L., for every hour.' I cleaned around the letters for an hour and did not touch them.

fragments.title: Leonardo's springs
fragments.text: The Codex Madrid has spring-driven mechanisms sketched centuries before they were common. I keep a copy of the page above my bench.

fragments.title: Beat error
fragments.text: My timing machine prints the rhythm of a movement as two lines. When they finally overlap perfectly, I always exhale out loud.
